ns2:course.label: Biomolecular Materials Science
ns2:course.description: Material anisotropy and elasto-plastic properties at the crystal level; microstructural basis for fatigue, fracture, and creep in metals, polymers, and ceramics; failure mechanisms and toughening in composites; structure and behavior of metal-matrix composites, ceramic-matrix composites, and polymer composites. Integrated with discussions of experimental characterization and manipulation techniques in biotechnology. A case study term project involving application of course content and expository research into current literature is required.
